activities.question: What does the -다 form indicate?
Choose the complete, grammatically correct sentence:

cards.back: Subject marker — marks who or what performs an action
The student comes. — 이 marks 학생 as the subject.
It rains. — 가 marks 비 as the subject.

activities.question: Which particle marks the subject in 학생이 와요?

cards.back: Object marker — marks what receives the action
I eat rice. — 을 marks 밥 as the object.
I study Korean. — 를 marks 한국어 as the object.

activities.question: Which particle marks the object in 밥을 먹어요?

cards.back: Marks a destination or a place where something is located
Marks the place where an action happens
I go to school. — 에 marks the destination.
I study at school. — 에서 marks where the action happens.
